target_customer: Real estate agencies and property managers in Colombia, plus tenants and landlords paying rent; originally online merchants for pay by bank
problem: Rent collection and payments in Colombia are manual and costly; at launch the founders targeted online card and PSE payment friction for merchants.
business_model: Payment commission on rent and transaction flow, SaaS for AI agents, plus credit and insurance products
product_category: Fintech for real estate in Latin America (rent payments, AI agents, credit)

founders.name: Cipriano Echavarria
founders.background_notes: YC page: Colombian; helped scale Nubank.

founders.name: Nicolas Gomez del Campo
founders.background_notes: YC page: Mexican; built algorithmic trading systems.

founders.name: Felipe Monsalve
founders.background_notes: YC page: also worked at MIT on a medical reporting system.

competitors.name: PSE (botón PSE/ACH)
competitors.what: Main existing online bank payment method in Colombia
competitors.traction_then: Incumbent default for bank payments online

technical_complexity.rationale: Direct bank connections and instant payment flows in Colombia need integrations with banks; later AI agents and credit products add complexity.

defensibility.rationale: Once agencies route rent flows through Palomma, switching is costly, and payment data supports credit underwriting; the original pay by bank wedge was less defensible.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Colombia's instant payment system, comparable to Brazil's Pix, was in development in 2023; Palomma saw it as a complement. No acquisition reported.

market_need_then: Forbes via LatAm Fintech Hub (Mar 2023) frames PSE friction for merchants as the pain; the founders targeted 2,000 merchants and 500,000 users by end 2023. Later rent flows of about 235 billion dollars (YC page claim) drove the real estate pivot.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, results driven and close; positions itself as an ally to real estate businesses, bilingual Spanish and English

branding.brand_signature: Product family naming: Palomma Pay, Plus, Protect, Advance, Flex

brand_strength.rationale: Coherent product naming but no sourced press about the brand itself; the name resembles the Spanish word paloma and common Paloma names, which is confusable in search.

pivots.from: Pay by Bank payments for online merchants
pivots.to: AI and payments for real estate rent in LatAm
pivots.why: Stated by sources as a move toward rent flows; the exact date and reason are not sourced.

outcome_analysis: Palomma pivoted from a pay by bank API into rent collection and AI for property managers in Colombia, and reports about 130 million dollars of monthly rent flow, over 500 agencies and about 3 million in ARR as of Nov 2026. The founders have strong fintech backgrounds and the pivot found real pull, leading to a 14 million Series A led by Cometa.
notes: Series A reported as 14M total by FF News, with Spanish outlets saying 10M Series A plus 4M previously undisclosed; the 14M is recorded as one entry dated Nov 2026. The 4M undisclosed portion's date is unknown. Pre-seed: Forbes via LatAm Fintech Hub says YC 500K (125K for 7 percent plus 375K investment). Company site also lists NFX and Volpe Capital as investors, not tied to rounds. The pivot date is not sourced beyond 2024 approximation; treat as approximate. Founders' date of this record: article dated 11 Nov 2026.
